reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, testable mechanism (Sn-rich interfacial diffusion barrier) directly supported by cited evidence of Sn suppressing pest oxidation in related Nb-silicide alloys, while acknowledging uncertainty and defining clear falsification conditions. Hypothesis B relies on Al2O3 scale formation, but its cited evidence does not directly support this mechanism in the equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr system and lacks the same level of mechanistic grounding for the proposed intervention.
